title: Mental Well-being of the Young Adult: Independence, Steadfastness, and Seeking Help (16-18 Years)
description: A pathway for the older adolescent preparing for legal adulthood: maintaining mental well-being in university/work, managing the pressures of independence, recognizing warning signs, and building a sustainable support network.

primary_reference.info: دليل APA للانتقال للرشد +leges الصحة النفسية للشباب

review_defects.why: The Arabic term 'الصحة النفسية' means 'mental health', a standard clinical and everyday term. The English uses 'mental well-being', which shifts the meaning from health (absence of illness) to a broader positive state. This is a subtle but real change in meaning.
